subject: POC handoff & sprint kickoff — calendar conflicts, room reqs, and recording policy
messages:
From: Elena Torres <elena.torres@cartopay.com>
To: jonas_weber@redwood.com
Cc: eng@cartopay.com
Date: 2027-07-12T09:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: POC kickoff — availability and on-site vs remote

Hi Jonas,

Thanks for the quick sync earlier. We're excited to get the hands-on sprint started. A few scheduling notes from our side: our engineering team is available w/c July 26 but several PMs are OOO the week of July 19, so we'd prefer July 26–28 if that works for your crew.

Two asks up front: 1) can you confirm whether the sessions will be recorded for our internal review? 2) we'll want a short load-test window during the final day (approx 90 minutes) — can your infra lead attend to coordinate routing and KV-cache warmup?

I've attached a rough milestone doc and our internal attendee list.

Thanks,
Elena
Elena Torres
Head of Integrations, CartoPay
elena.torres@cartopay.com
[Attachment: cartopay_poc_milestones.docx]

From: jonas_weber@redwood.com
To: Elena Torres <elena.torres@cartopay.com>
Cc: marcu_lin@redwood.com, olga_petrov@redwood.com, monica_patel@redwood.com
Date: 2027-07-13T10:18:00-07:00
Subject: Re: POC kickoff — availability and on-site vs remote

Thanks Elena — July 26–28 works on our end. Quick notes and proposals: 

- Agenda: Day 1 (kickoff + prompt review & routing demo), Day 2 (hands-on sessions + integration points), Day 3 (load tests + wrap).
- Recording: We can record walkthroughs and demos but need explicit consent from on-site observers; can redact or limit access after the run. I suggest recordings be off for purely internal exec conversations — we can mark session recordings in the agenda and capture only the technical demos.
- Load test: Marcus (cc'd) will own the load window. He needs 60–90 minutes and prefers the afternoon of Day 3.
- Room/AV: If you go on-site, we need a room with HDMI + mics for 12 people and a wired Ethernet drop for the bench machines. If remote, we'll run the same content but will ask you to provision a host VM with 4 GPUs for the load window.

I'm looping Marcus and Olga to confirm capacity and AV staffing; Monica will coordinate calendar invites and visitor access. Can you confirm whether CartoPay will send a list of onsite attendees (for badges) and if you need NDAs/signed media consent for recordings?

Best,
Jonas Weber
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
jonas_weber@redwood.com
Phone: +1 (415) 555-0124

From: marcu_lin@redwood.com
To: jonas_weber@redwood.com, Elena Torres <elena.torres@cartopay.com>
Cc: olga_petrov@redwood.com, monica_patel@redwood.com
Date: 2027-07-14T08:42:00-07:00
Subject: Re: POC kickoff — availability and on-site vs remote

Sorry for the terse reply — Marcus here.

Load-test notes:
- We can do a 90-minute window on afternoon of July 28 starting 1:30pm PT. Plan: ramp to target RPS over 20 minutes, 50 minutes steady state, 20 minute cooldown.
- Routing: we'll exercise fallback routing to a smaller quantized variant; please ensure the test VM has model-v2-8q available as fallback.
- KV cache warmup: we'll need sample prefixes to warm caches (Elena, can you provide 2–3 representative prompt sets by July 21?).

Attachments: preliminary load plan attached (load_test_plan.xlsx).

I'll be onsite for the load window if you choose to host; if remote, I can join the cluster run.

-Marcus
Marcus Lin
Lead Infra / Performance | Redwood Inference
[Attachment: load_test_plan.xlsx]

From: Elena Torres <elena.torres@cartopay.com>
To: jonas_weber@redwood.com, marcu_lin@redwood.com
Cc: eng@cartopay.com, monica_patel@redwood.com
Date: 2027-07-15T11:10:00-07:00
Subject: Re: POC kickoff — availability and on-site vs remote

Thanks Marcus — we can provide 3 prompt sets by EOD Jul 21.

On the onsite list: we'll have 6 engineers (names attached in the milestone doc) and 2 PMs for the kickoff. We will need visitor badges for those 8 people — can Monica share the badge submission link? Also, regarding recordings: CartoPay is fine with demos being recorded for internal playback; we request that meeting chat and any attendee recordings are limited to participants only (no posting to public channels).

One last ask — is there a preferred seating/layout to ensure the bench machines have good network performance? I've attached our conference room layout for reference.

-Elena

Hi Elena — Monica from Customer Ops here. Quick logistics checklist and actions: 

- Calendar: I’ve sent invites for July 26–28 (blocks + detailed agenda). Please accept or propose changes to the 1:1s. Link: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=abcd1234
- Visitor badges: Please upload attendee names here by July 23: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-cartopay-poc. We'll submit to security for ground-floor access.
- AV/Network: We've booked Conf Rm C (cap 14) with dual projectors and wired 2x 10Gb drops to bench tables; room layout attached (room_layout.png). If you want reserved bench racks for model servers, we can pre-stage.
- Recording consent: We'll add a consent checkbox to the agenda invites and mark which sessions are recorded. Recordings will be stored in a private bucket with access control to CartoPay attendees only.
- NDAs/media consent: CartoPay legal asked for a template; attaching a one-page media consent — if you want it signed we'll route to Legal.

Next steps (action owners):
- Elena: upload prompt sets by Jul 21 (owner: CartoPay)
- Marcus: finalize load script and peak RPS (owner: Marcus)
- Jonas: finalize prompt walkthrough slides and share with Elena by Jul 22
- Monica: confirm badge submission link and invite attendees (owner: Monica)

Thanks — see you the week of the 26th.

Regards,
Monica Patel
Customer Operations | Redwood Inference
